Sai Net Services & Sanika Enterprises is a Consumer Services company. Aditi Enterprises & Sanika Enterprises is a networking solutions service provider based in Nandurbar, Maharashtra, India. They offer a range of products and services including networking solutions, broadband service, remote access VPN solution service, virtual private network service, networking cctv camera, fingerprint machine, and iris scanner.
